about: Brampton is a large city in the western Greater Toronto Area, north of Mississauga in Peel Region. It has grown quickly as a suburban industrial and residential municipality. South Asian communities are a large part of local shops, places of worship, and festivals. About 660,000 people live in Brampton.
seoSummary: Fast-growing Peel Region city in the western GTA, with a large South Asian community.
knownFor: Rapid suburban growth in Peel Region
